scripts.build:site: P=${SITE_PREFIX:-optimized-dl}; rm -rf public & for f in pages/*.md; do n=$(basename "$f" .md); npm run build -- "$f" --base "/$P/$n/" --out "../public/$n" || exit 1; done && cp -R index.html images public/
scripts.preview:site: P=${SITE_PREFIX:-optimized-dl}; mkdir -p /tmp/$P-preview && ln -sfn "$PWD/public" /tmp/$P-preview/$P && echo "Open http://localhost:3000/$P/" && npx serve /tmp/$P-preview --symlinks
scripts.site: npm run build:site && npm run preview:site
